description: The existing registry denotes the named commercial Difco Marine Broth 2216 preparation. The manufacturer manual, printed pages 351-352, independently lists broth and agar formulas: broth has magnesium chloride 5.9 g and magnesium sulfate 3.24 g per litre at standard reconstitution; agar has magnesium chloride 8.8 g and sodium sulfate 3.24 g. Thus the products do not differ only by agar. The corrected sixteen-part commercial broth formula is retained; unspecified salt forms remain UNMAPPED. The old MIM curation (#260) assertion and ATCC agar-minus-agar transcription are historical provenance, not the active identity basis. This source-bound correction does not merge generic marine-medium owners or resolve worker03 same-owner alias reconciliation.
identity_consequence: Source-defined whole preparation; named components are not whole-record identity.
